query:
insert into
                entries(namespace, key_name, nonce, encrypted_value, created_at, updated_at, expired_at)
                values ($1, $2, $3, $4, datetime('now'), datetime('now'), $5)
                on conflict (namespace, key_name) do update set
                  nonce = $3
                , encrypted_value = $4
                , updated_at = datetime('now')
                , expired_at = $5
